title: Data workflow (Apache Airflow job) settings and when to use them
objective_text: Decide when an Apache Airflow job fits better than a pipeline, and which of its settings handle versions, packages, idle time and DAG sources.
scenario: Two teams want orchestration in the same workspace: one writes Airflow DAGs in Python, the other doesn't write code. Operations wants idle environments to stop using compute.
verifies: You can pick the right feature, setting or operator for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
